plugins.name: evals
plugins.description: Connect your repo to evals.tessary.ai and work with your evals from the coding agent — wire trace ingestion over OTLP, tag your call sites, assess graders, query failing traces, read the cases and root-cause reports the platform opens, and author per-call-site SOP-conformance files (derive from the code, reconcile on change, lint locally). The platform's observer authors and maintains your eval bundle from there.

plugins.name: crew
plugins.description: A multi-agent dev harness: hand it a goal and the orchestrator triages, implements, reviews, and maintains your repo — autonomously, up to a review-ready PR.

plugins.name: tessary
plugins.description: Self-host Tessary, an open-source agent reliability platform, and wire your repo's tracing to it — install and start the local instance, instrument your model-call spans with tessary.call_site.id, and connect Claude Code's MCP tools to a project so the agent can read cases, findings, and traces natively.

plugins.name: gtm
plugins.description: Host your CRM in Notion and run your go-to-market flow from Claude Code: set up or map the databases, import from another CRM, sweep your inbox, calendar, LinkedIn and outreach tools into the CRM every day, build and write campaigns in your voice, send them with safety gates, and report the funnel.
